create_InstanceFlow: create an InstanceFlow dataclass instance with a LogContext and instance_id to track a container instance lifecycle
build_InstanceFlow_with_stages: build an InstanceFlow with FlowStage entries to record the progression of an instance through pipeline stages
serialize_InstanceFlow_to_json: serialize an InstanceFlow object to JSON using the dataclasses_json decorator for logging and reporting
track_InstanceFlow_error_lines: track error log lines and their count in an InstanceFlow to monitor failed containers during execution
deserialize_InstanceFlow_from_json: deserialize a JSON string into an InstanceFlow dataclass object to reconstruct instance flow state from stored logs
